detail.title: Yomobile
detail.body: YO Mobile is a Mexico-based telecom and super-app platform designed to combine mobile service with a broader digital ecosystem—blending connectivity, content, and lifestyle features into a single product experience. During its early launch phase, I led web development across both the public-facing site and internal platforms, helping translate a bold, campaign-driven brand into scalable digital systems. Working closely with design, product, and a Ukraine-based backend and data team, I built and maintained the infrastructure supporting both customer acquisition and internal decision-making. My work focused on developing responsive frontend systems and data-driven interfaces, including marketing sites, custom email frameworks, analytics integrations, and an investor portal for reporting and company updates. The result was a set of tools that supported both the outward brand experience and the internal operations behind it.
